mintAuthority.summary: nWISDOM is a Nest vault share on the Nucleus/BoringVault architecture; the permissioned Teller mints/burns shares when users deposit pUSD at vault NAV, while the Nest-controlled Manager directs WisdomTree-fund allocation. Both Teller and Manager are owned by the same Nest 3-of-6 Safe.

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295096, owner() on both Teller and Manager returned 0xa08A0Dc480BD60d1d56C8EeC6c722125eAfEa982. Safe API confirmed: 3-of-6 threshold, version 1.3.0+L2, no modules, no guard.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295096: owner() on Wisdom Vault Teller (0xA1D572b6) and Manager (0x8226B661) both returned 0xa08A0Dc480BD60d1d56C8EeC6c722125eAfEa982. Safe API confirmed 3-of-6 Safe, version 1.3.0+L2, modules [], guard zero. Shared Safe with ntbill-nest. All mint-capable surfaces confirmed. Evidence challenge completed 2026-07-15: Nest publishes issuer-operated hourly NAV and live vault composition, with the latest public vault-data snapshot dated 2026-07-08, but no recurring independent reconciliation of nWISDOM supply to portfolio assets was found. Regulation of underlying WisdomTree products does not prudentially supervise the Nest wrapper issuer. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: the Nest Safe controls the uncapped Teller/Manager issuance path, while issuer NAV and composition data do not reconcile whole supply and no wrapper regulator or independent attestor is evidenced. Wave 2 external verification 2026-08-15: current Nest documentation adds BNB Chain and Solana issuance surfaces but still provides only issuer-operated portfolio data rather than independent whole-supply reconciliation. Reconciliation review 2026-08-15: Nest's dated Available Vaults snapshot describes nWISDOM as a multi-asset private-credit vault share and its Audits register lists smart-contract audits, but no named third-party report or recurring attestation reconciling total nWISDOM liabilities across its EVM and Solana issuance surfaces to the portfolio was found; the available evidence therefore remains insufficient for periodic reconciliation.
